blender-any.clarifying_question: What do you want to animate — a character, an object, a scene? What's the subject or story?

todo.objective: A personal to-do list app (mobile-first, single user) that lets a user create, organize, and complete tasks, with data persisted locally and across sessions.

capabilities.reason: build and ship the core to-do app UI and logic on iOS
persist tasks locally and keep them reliable across app launches
add a widget or share extension for quickly adding tasks

screws.objective: Build a machine that dispenses screws one at a time, counts them, and syncs inventory counts to an online parts database.

capabilities.reason: must separate and dispense one screw at a time from a bulk hopper
count dispensed screws, likely via weight sensing
control the dispenser mechanism and read sensors
send dispense/count events from device to the online database
expose an API backing the online parts database
model parts inventory data with sane keys and quantities
design hopper/chute geometry sized to fit screws of varying dimensions

rc-truck.clarifying_question: Do you want to build/print a custom RC truck chassis and body, or modify an existing RC truck (e.g. add electronics, a custom mount, or off-road upgrades)?

coaster.objective: Build a smart coaster PCB that detects the presence/weight of a drink placed on it using a weight sensor.

capabilities.reason: sense drink weight via strain gauge or load sensor
capture coaster circuit schematic
route a compact round PCB and fabricate it
firmware to read sensor and process weight readings
assemble small SMD components onto the coaster board
battery powered coaster needs sized, isolated power for sensing and any wireless radio

knob.objective: A single smart rotary knob device that simulates different tactile feel profiles (detents, springs, end-stops) which can be reprogrammed per application, using a motor and encoder with haptic feedback firmware.

capabilities.reason: must read precise absolute knob position to know where it is in its rotation
must design and tune the virtual detent/spring/friction feel profiles that make the knob 'dynamic'
needs closed-loop torque control on the motor to render force feedback smoothly
control loop must be tuned against real encoder feedback for stable torque response
firmware running on a microcontroller must be programmable to switch between profiles
motor and logic rails need to be sized and isolated in the small knob enclosure
knob body and internal mounting for motor/encoder need to be modeled and printed

birds.objective: Create a drawn illustration depicting a row of birds lined up along a beach shoreline.

capabilities.reason: requires drawing birds and a beach scene with correct anatomy, perspective and composition

printed.clarifying_question: What object do you want to 3D print — e.g. a phone stand, a tool organizer, a part to fix something?

fishtank.objective: A short Blender animation depicting the point of view of a fish looking out through a restaurant fish tank into a Chinese restaurant dining room.

capabilities.reason: model the fish tank, fish, and restaurant interior props
create underwater glass/water refraction and restaurant lighting materials
rig the fish for swimming motion
animate fish swimming and camera movement with believable weight and timing
block a POV camera looking out from inside the tank into the restaurant
render passes and composite the underwater distortion look with the restaurant background
producing fan art of Apothecary Diaries characters requires solid drawing fundamentals whether traditional or as a basis for AI-assisted work
generating a specific stylized look via an AI image model requires deliberate prompt/workflow control
depicting the same Apothecary Diaries characters recognizably and consistently across multiple generated images

apothecary.objective: Create AI-generated fan art of characters from the anime/manga Apothecary Diaries in a consistent anime style.

capabilities.reason: characters and props must be modeled in Blender
characters need armatures to be posed and animated
shot needs correct timing and weight to read as animation
90's anime look requires a cel-shaded non-photoreal style
shot needs a blocked, animated camera to feel cinematic
final look needs render passes and color grading to match 90's film aesthetic

anime90s.objective: Create a short Blender-animated scene styled after 90's cel-shaded anime, featuring a character with toon shading and film-grain compositing.

golf-mount.objective: A 3D-printed mount that attaches to a golf bag and holds an iPhone at a stable angle to record golf swings.

capabilities.reason: measure golf bag strap/frame tube and iPhone dimensions to design a snug clamp fit
model the mount body parametrically in CAD
mount must hold the phone rigid while walking or swinging so footage isn't blurry
choose filament tough enough for outdoor use and repeated clamping stress
adjustable angle/hinge mechanism so phone can be aimed at the swing without binding

gacha.objective: A mobile gacha game where players collect anime-style character ("waifu") cards and use them to cook dishes, progressing through recipe/collection systems with gacha pulls for new characters.

capabilities.reason: needs a core game loop and scene flow (menu, cooking, gacha pull, results)
needs drop rates, pity system and progression design for character pulls
needs touch UI for cooking mechanics, gacha pulls and collection screens
needs to save player progress, collected characters and currency across sessions
needs consistent character art across many gacha cards and scenes
needs to generate a large volume of character art on a specific style
needs the actual cooking gameplay mechanic (recipe matching, timing, or resource combination system)

pokemon-bin.objective: A 3D-printed storage system for bulk Pokemon cards (or similar collectibles), with bins/dividers color-coded and organized by type for sorting and storage.

capabilities.reason: model the bin/divider system parametrically to fit standard card dimensions and stack together
design modular interlocking bins or dividers that connect without fasteners
ensure card sleeves/stacks fit snugly in bins with correct clearance
pick filament and print orientation suitable for repeated handling and stacking
define a color/label scheme mapping Pokemon types to bin colors or printed labels
capabilities.resolve_why: same concept of designing color/type labels for storage bins, previously rejected as not a skill

gridfinity.objective: A gridfinity-compatible tray with tool-shaped cutouts (e.g. for screwdrivers, pliers, allen keys) sized to fit measured tools, printed in standard gridfinity module dimensions to slot into a gridfinity base grid.

capabilities.reason: cutouts must be traced/measured from actual tools and fit snugly
gridfinity modules and cutout profiles need to be modeled parametrically to standard grid units
choosing filament and orientation for a durable tool tray

ledger.objective: A mobile/web app called "Ledger" that lets a user track their stock portfolio holdings, transactions, and current value using live market data.

capabilities.reason: build and ship the portfolio tracker as a mobile app
pull live stock price data from an external market data API
model holdings, transactions and portfolios in a normalized schema
build backend API with user authentication to store portfolio data
allow viewing and updating portfolio data without constant connectivity

dryer.objective: Build a wall-mounted shower attachment that blows warm air over the user's body after washing to dry them off without a towel, using a blower and heating element sized for skin-safe airflow, controlled by an embedded system with a wet-rated enclosure.

capabilities.reason: must size a blower and heating element to safely and effectively dry a body in reasonable time
device is mounted inside a shower and must survive direct water exposure
heating element and blower need safe mains power design in a wet environment (GFCI etc.)
needs embedded control logic for heater/blower operation, timers and safety cutoffs
custom housing and duct/nozzle geometry must be modeled for the shower mount
must isolate and size power rails for heater and blower alongside control electronics

verstappen.objective: Create a short 3D animated clip of a Max Verstappen-style F1 race car driving/racing on a track, rendered with realistic materials and camera work.

capabilities.reason: need a clean race car mesh (and possibly track/environment) to animate
car paint, livery, tire and asphalt materials need believable shading and lighting
wheels, suspension and steering need rigged controls for animation
car motion needs correct speed, weight and timing to read as a race
shot needs a moving camera that tracks the car dynamically
final render passes need compositing for motion blur, speed lines and color grade

gundam.objective: Build a Gundam-style robot head model with a moving transformation mechanism and a camera-based tracking system that turns the head to follow a person entering the room.

capabilities.reason: model the Gundam head shell and internal structural parts
design the transformation linkage that moves head panels/parts without binding
drive multiple servos for transformation and pan/tilt head motion
detect a person entering the room via camera
convert noisy person detections into smooth head pan/tilt targets
microcontroller code to coordinate servos, sensor input and transformation sequence
